snippet.title: Pichenette - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Our first game Pichenette is now live!
It’s a flick-fighting game built around fast matches with simple controls. Perfect for having a laugh with friends, settling old rivalries, or deciding who’s doing the dishes or cleaning the place (you know, the usual).

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171500/Pichenette/
